exhibits.title: The Upper Floor — World Models
exhibits.text: The Upper Floor: world models, the predictive arts. The Divination Wing studies how a model learns to predict what is HIDDEN — I-JEPA's prediction in latent space, VICReg's three laws against collapse, the projector's guillotine, and the state of the wider JEPA realm. These arts stand a floor above Attention for good reason: their encoders are built from the very mechanism kept downstairs. Nothing here is decoration — every mirror, cauldron and statue is a working metaphor for something real.

exhibits.title: How to Walk
exhibits.text: Move with W, A, S, D and look with the mouse. Approach any exhibit and press E to study it closely; press E again or Escape to step back. Press M for the map of this floor, G for the constellation of ideas, and F to travel by Floo to any chamber you know the name of. The staircase down returns you to the Ground Floor — the Atrium of Attention these world models are built upon.
